reports.limitations: No host discovery, game load or SSH; label observation not full render. Go tab switches differ from Bash submenu transitions. ASCII/no-color test mode. RSS is main process, not session PSS. Short idle sample, observational only.

Startup is initial static/default-balanced render; other profiles are selected after startup. Navigation observes markers, not full frames. Idle has one observation per mode, CPU interval uses timestamps at stat reads, memory samples include stat RSS and optional rollup RSS/PSS for the main process only; waited-child CPU excludes running children at boundaries. No game load, physical host, SSH or long-run leak conclusion. Shared runner; observational, no absolute performance gate.
